# The engine requires a newer go line than this module's. muxt test raises it
# in the copy of go.mod it hands go test, not in the module's own, and says
# nothing about it: in a healthy run the output is go test's alone.

muxt test
stdout '^ok  \tserver\t'
! stderr .
grep '^go 1\.24$' go.mod

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- render_test.go --
package server

import "testing"

func TestRuns(t *testing.T) {}
